stops.title: AC generator, RMS & average values
stops.inShort: Alternating emf e = e₀ sin(ωt). RMS values: I_rms = I₀/√2 ≈ 0.707 I₀, E_rms = E₀/√2 ≈ 0.707 E₀. Average value over half cycle: I_avg = 2I₀/π ≈ 0.637 I₀ (zero over full cycle).

stops.title: AC through R, L, C & series LCR circuit
stops.inShort: Pure R: I in phase with V. Pure L: I lags V by π/2, X_L = ωL = 2πfL. Pure C: I leads V by π/2, X_C = 1/(ωC) = 1/(2πfC). Series LCR impedance Z = √(R² + (X_L − X_C)²), tan φ = (X_L − X_C)/R.

stops.title: Power in AC circuit & LC oscillations
stops.inShort: Average power P_avg = E_rms I_rms cos φ, where cos φ = R/Z is the power factor. In pure L or pure C, φ = ±90° so cos φ = 0 (wattless current).

stops.title: Electric resonance, Q-factor & choke coil
stops.inShort: At series resonance X_L = X_C, Z_min = R, current is maximum, resonant frequency f_r = 1 / (2π √(LC)). Quality factor Q = ω_r L / R = (1/R) √(L/C).

items.f: X_L = 2π f L,  X_C = 1/(2π f C),  Z = √(R² + (X_L − X_C)²)
items.s: Phase angle: tan φ = (X_L − X_C) / R.

items.f: P_avg = E_rms I_rms cos φ,  cos φ = R / Z
f_r = 1 / (2π √(L C)),  Q = ω_r L / R
items.s: At resonance, X_L = X_C and Z = R.

board.text: In a series LCR circuit, if resistance, inductive reactance and capacitive reactance are 3 Ω, 8 Ω and 4 Ω respectively, calculate phase difference between voltage and current.
board.answer:
Given: R = 3 Ω, X_L = 8 Ω, X_C = 4 Ω.
tan φ = (X_L − X_C) / R = (8 − 4) / 3 = 4 / 3 ≈ 1.3333.
φ = tan⁻¹(4/3) = 53° 8' (or 53.13°), voltage leads current.

board.text: A 100 Ω resistor is connected to a 220 V, 50 Hz supply. Calculate: (a) r.m.s. value of current and (b) net power consumed over the full cycle.
board.answer:
Given: R = 100 Ω, E_rms = 220 V, f = 50 Hz.
(a) I_rms = E_rms / R = 220 / 100 = 2.2 A.
(b) P_avg = E_rms × I_rms × cos 0° = 220 × 2.2 × 1 = 484 W.

board.text: What is series resonance? Obtain an expression for resonant frequency of a series LCR circuit.
board.answer:
Series resonance is the condition in a series LCR circuit when inductive reactance equals capacitive reactance (X_L = X_C), making impedance minimum (Z = R) and current maximum.
At resonance: X_L = X_C ⇒ ω_r L = 1 / (ω_r C) ⇒ 2π f_r L = 1 / (2π f_r C)
⇒ f_r² = 1 / (4π² L C) ⇒ f_r = 1 / (2π √(L C)).
